column1: # patch-windows.tsv: Mendix patch releases not to pick as an upgrade target ("do not target X, take Y or later").
# Read by bin/mxversion.py (--check, --pick; SKILL.md rule LTS-1, steps/triage.md item 2). Only facts the public Studio Pro
# release notes state; a patch is never listed on a hunch. Columns: id, from, to (last bad patch, inclusive), fixed_in,
# applies_if (tag: "always", or a feature tag the caller passes as --uses <tag>), effect, why, source.
# effect "refuse": --check exits 1 and --pick skips it. "warn": --check prints WARN and exits 0, --pick prefers another
# patch. A row whose tag is not "always" and was not passed in --uses is treated as WARN ("applies if ..."): the toolkit
# cannot see whether the app uses the feature, so it never stays silent and never refuses on a guess.
# 11.6.0 is a warn: the version number is sound, only a download made 2025-12-23 to 2026-01-06 may be the wrong build.

column7: Retracted: database schema migration fails at startup on a database created before 10.17 that uses foreign key constraints. Take 10.24.8 or later.
A wrong build of 11.6.0 was published for downloads between 2025-12-23 and 2026-01-06. Download 11.6.0 again, or take a later 11.6 patch.

Remote (external) entities with a Decimal primary key cause errors on startup on existing deployments. The 11.6.3 notes list the fix; the window start is the first 11.6 release (the notes name no earlier fix).
Client certificate authentication (REST, OData, Web Services) sends no certificate. The notes say do not upgrade to this version if you use it; take 11.12.6.
Same client certificate known issue as 11.12.5. The notes say do not upgrade to this version if you use it; take 10.24.28.
